items.t: Atlanta Braves: Successful Season Is Over, Now Heading Into Short-Term Unknowns
items.sum: The bull case for the Atlanta Braves: the analyst values it at $75 per share using 6.5x baseball revenue and a 7% Battery cap rate.

items.t: Manchester United: Time To Show The Red Card (Rating Downgrade)
items.sum: Analyst rates Manchester United plc a Sell: 15.17x forward EV/EBITDA leaves little upside against essentially flat fiscal 2027 adjusted EBITDA guidance.
